window.missed_start_rule: If the window is not activated before its first review, this version expires; freeze a new version before observing replacement-window outcomes.

research_question: Does the open + close review cadence remain operationally coherent and competitive with passive references in a prospectively logged paper window without mid-window tuning?

universe.selection_rule: Fixed before the first observation; no additions, deletions, or substitutions during the window.
universe.rationale: A frozen, liquid ETF set reduces single-name corporate-action and current-listing-universe concerns. It does not reproduce the historical broad-stock universe.

data.availability_rule: Only records with available_at at or before the decision cutoff may enter context.
data.source_activation_record: A licensed or otherwise authorized provider and retrieval method must be named and hashed before the first review; this does not permit changing any strategy field.
data.public_repository_rule: Do not commit vendor data, credentials, account records, or raw model sessions.

agent.fallback: Malformed, unavailable, or timed-out invocation becomes a logged no-trade decision.

execution.fill_rule: Next timestamped bar after the decision cutoff; never the context bar.

logging.state_recovery: A SQLite fill-journal drill verifies idempotent paper-fill restoration. Activation still requires wiring it into the prospective runner plus a durable checkpoint for pending decisions and tournament state.
logging.public_redaction: Publish only aggregate outcomes and safe synthetic examples.

evaluation.reporting_rule: Report all metrics and failures once after the window; do not stop or tune because of performance.
evaluation.sharpe_note: Retain the repository-reported formula for comparability and also report a frequency-corrected statistic before external review.
evaluation.success_rule: Completion means protocol adherence and interpretable evidence, not a required positive return or benchmark excess.

change_control.safety_exception: Pause on data-integrity, risk, or logging failure; record the failure. Do not silently repair and resume.
change_control.new_version_rule: Any prompt, model, universe, cadence, data, risk, execution, or metric change requires a new hash and future window before outcomes are observed.
